page_title: GEN 1-2 ACM | Genoa v AC Milan 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+10' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Justin Bijlow makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom right corner.
90+9' AC Milan take a short corner kick.

90+8' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the bottom right corner of the target, but the keeper leaps like a salmon to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping! The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AC Milan.
90+1' That will be all from Amorim who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Aaron Martin (Genoa).
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
90' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' The ball is cleared after Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Genoa.
89' The resulting set piece from AC Milan is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
89' AC Milan have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. AC Milan force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' 1 - 2 Goal! Johan Vasquez (Genoa) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:2.
86' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
85' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Ardon Jashari is replaced by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) coming on for Lorenzo Colombo.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
84' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and Genoa will have a corner.
83' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Mike Maignan pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Genoa earn a corner.

81' 0 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) and Christian Pulisic gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 0:2.
76' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Christopher Nkunku will be replaced by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
76' Substitution. Fikayo Tomori leaves the pitch and is replaced by Koni De Winter (AC Milan).
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.
73' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Good work from Genoa as they win a corner.
72' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
68' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) replacing Youssouf Fofana.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) comes onto the pitch for Santiago Tomas Gimenez.
67' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
67' Simone Sozza blows the whistle, Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) is penalised for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Genoa.
65' Substitution. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) on for Tommaso Baldanzi.
63' Vitinha (Genoa) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off. Vitinha (Genoa) will miss the next game.
63' The whistle blows and Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is booked for an infringement.
59' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
50' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Justin Bijlow no chance!
50' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
48' Justin Bijlow (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' Poor challenge! Justin Bijlow (Genoa) is penalised for tripping and Simone Sozza blows his whistle. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to AC Milan!
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
40' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
40' AC Milan win a corner.
38' The ball possession is 67:33.
30' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post.
27' Morten Frendrup finds Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
25' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
25' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa). Simone Sozza saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. That's a free kick to AC Milan.
23' Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
14' Vitinha (Genoa) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Tommaso Baldanzi.
8' Vitinha (Genoa) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired high over the crossbar.
8' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simone Sozza blows for a foul. Genoa have been awarded a free kick.
3' Amorim (Genoa) is able to continue to play.
2' Amorim (Genoa) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! AC Milan will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Simone Sozza.
